_comment: TEMPLATE for a VisionALVR headset profile. Copy it, rename it <your-headset>.profile.json, fill it with values YOU have run, and share the file (for example on the VisionALVR Discord). To use one: drop the file into the config\\profiles folder next to VisionALVR.exe (create it if it does not exist); the setup wizard matches it to your headset at the handshake. Delete every key you do not need; only `id`, `stream` and `network` are required. A profile only changes this PC's configuration files (session.json) and is never downloaded automatically.
author: your name or handle

name_contains: part of the name the headset reports

variants.label: describe the network this bitrate was tested on

verified.result: what you observed (fps, latency, packet loss)
